test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest, compounded annually, on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 19% per annum is ₹590. Find the sum [rounded off to the nearest integer].
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **2 years**, the difference between **CI** and **SI** is given by the formula: **Difference = P × (R/100)²**.

Given **Rate (R) = 19%** and **Difference = ₹590**.

590 = P × (19/100)²

590 = P × (361/10000) ⇒ P = (590 × 10000) ÷ 361

P = 5900000 ÷ 361 ≈ ₹16,343.49

**∴ The correct answer is ₹16,343.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Rate (R)** = 19% per annum

**Difference (CI − SI)** = ₹590

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) for 2 years = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Compound Interest (CI) for 2 years = P[(1 + R/100)² − 1]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d981d36ce61a24557a350ea92de0c5f52f77a6d4a731e18a62e837a502b21d8.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 2 years = (P × 19 × 2) ÷ 100 = 0.38P

⇒ CI for 2 years = P[(1 + 19/100)² − 1]

⇒ CI = P[(119/100)² − 1] = P[1.4161 − 1] = 0.4161P

⇒ Difference (CI − SI) = 0.4161P − 0.38P = 0.0361P

⇒ 0.0361P = 590

⇒ P = 590 ÷ 0.0361

⇒ P ≈ ₹16,343.49

**∴ The correct answer is ₹16,343.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between CI and SI for 3 years is given by: Difference = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Effective Rate Method

For 2 years, the effective CI rate is R + R + (R×R)/100. The SI rate is 2R. The difference is simply (R²/100)%.

Compound Interest Half-Yearly

If compounded half-yearly, the rate becomes R/2 and the time becomes 2n years.
